entities.name: Otharri
entities.description: A fiery phoenix on New Phyrexia who protects Neyali and is a Mirran symbol of hope.

entities.name: Neyali
entities.description: Vulshok who collected the egg and escaped Phyrexians with it.

entities.name: Slagmaw
entities.description: Mirran resistance camp that became their home.

events.summary: Phyrexians decimate Neyali's Vulshok village and she flees with the egg; Otharri hatches during the escape.
events.quote: The fiery phoenix Otharri hatched during this escape

events.summary: The Mirrans welcome Otharri, who lends his fire to forge stronger weapons.
events.quote: they welcomed Otharri with open arms

relations.quote: he vowed to protect his guardian with his very life
